description: Graphite used in place of or mixed with red chalk as a ground for edge gilding. It darkens and smooths the edge so the gold polishes to a deep lustre; some gilders prefer it alone, others combine it with chalk.
name: blacklead

source_ref.label: Douglas Cockerell, Bookbinding and the Care of Books (1902), Chapter VI, p.96. Internet Archive.
